SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
WEDNESDAY - APRIL 10, 2024 - 07:00 P.M.
MAIN THEATER - CERRITOS CENTER FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS
18000 PARK PLAZA DRIVE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made during regular business hours by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248.
Order of Agenda
The City Council, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Main Theater.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or in writing as described below. Public comments are limited to items listed on this special meeting agenda only.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk at 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703 no later than 12:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 12:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting and the document(s) will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 or at city_clerk@cerritos.us in advance of the meeting to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE SUCCESSOR
AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD THURSDAY, APRIL 10, 2024,
7:00 P.M., IN THE MAIN THEATER AT CERRITOS CENTER FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS,
18000 PARK PLAZA DRIVE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.

 1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

 2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Brent Eldridge, Arbor Road Church, Long Beach.

 3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Boy Scout Troop 72.

 4.  Performance of the National Anthem

  The National Anthem was performed by Sofia Aniceto.

 5.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Lynda P. Johnson
  Council/Agency Member Chuong Vo
  Council/Agency Member Frank Aurelio Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Naresh Solanki
  Mayor/Chair Bruce W. Barrows

 6.  Public Comments (Special Meeting Agenda Item 7)

  (Notation: Special meeting public comments were limited to Item 7 as listed on the special
  meeting agenda).

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Written public comments:

  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer, announced that written public comments submitted by
  the deadline listed on the agenda are considered public record. Prior to the meeting, the
  Council/Agency members received full-text, unredacted copies of the one (1) written
  comment submitted under Item 6 for Item 7. Requests for copies of the written comments
  submitted for this meeting can be made during regular business hours to the Office of the
  City Clerk/Treasurer.

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to provide public comment, the Mayor
  declared the public comments period closed.

 7.  Annual Mayoral Transition and City Council/Successor Agency Reorganization
  Ceremony

  A.  Welcome and introductions

  Mayor Barrows introduced dignitaries in attendance. Each Councilmember, the Mayor
  Pro Tem, and the Mayor introduced their family and guests in attendance.
 City of Cerritos  Wednesday, April 10, 2024, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting  Page 2 of 3

7.  Annual Mayoral Transition and City Council/Successor Agency Reorganization
  Ceremony (continued)

  B.  Recognition of outgoing Mayor/Chair and presentations by dignitaries

  Presentations were made to outgoing Mayor Bruce W. Barrows. A video was displayed
  highlighting Mayor Barrows’ year of service.

  C.  Selection of Mayor/Chair and Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair

  Mayor/Chair Barrows declared the office of Mayor/Chair vacant and called for
  nominations for the office of Mayor/Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Barrows nominated Council/Agency Member Solanki for the
  office of Mayor/Chair.

  Noting there were no further nominations, the City Clerk declared nominations closed.

  NOMINATION: As nominated by Council/Agency Member Barrows, Council/Agency
  Member Solanki was presented for consideration as Mayor/Chair (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR
  AGENCY).

  The nomination carried (4 - 1) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Johnson, Solanki, Vo
  NOES:  Yokoyama
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  The City Clerk declared Council/Agency Member Solanki as Mayor/Chair.

  The City Clerk declared the office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair vacant and called for
  nominations for the office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  Mayor/Chair Solanki nominated Council/Agency Member Vo for the office of Mayor Pro
  Tem/Vice Chair.

  Noting there were no further nominations, the City Clerk declared nominations closed.

  NOMINATION: As nominated by Mayor/Chair Solanki, Council/Agency Member Vo was
  presented for consideration as Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR
  AGENCY).

  The nomination carried (3 - 2) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  Johnson, Yokoyama
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  The City Clerk declared Council/Agency Member Vo as Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  D.  Remarks by incoming Mayor/Chair, Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair, and
  Councilmembers

  Comments were made by Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Vo, Mayor/Chair Solanki, and
  Councilmembers Johnson and Yokoyama.
 City of Cerritos  Wednesday, April 10, 2024, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting  Page 3 of 3

7.  Annual Mayoral Transition and City Council/Successor Agency Reorganization
  Ceremony (continued)

  E.  Conclusion of ceremony

  Mayor/Chair Solanki invited the community to a reception at the Cerritos Center for the
  Performing Arts in the Sierra Room.

8.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 8:30 p.m.

  /s/ Vida Barone
